title: Coach v9 Observer Correction
description: Observer correction payload. Producer: observer-correction track (#L1). Consumer: runtime watcher (#J5) which performs the actual injection. Stored append-only in `.atdd/runtime/agents/<id>/corrections.jsonl`. Spec: atdd-coach-spec-v9.md §C0.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent the correction targets.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier (`<DOMAIN>-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` per substrate rule-id grammar) the correction is anchored on.

disposition.description: Coach v9 disposition that drove the correction. Aligns with the substrate disposition vocabulary.

correction_text.description: Human-readable correction copy. Injected verbatim into the agent's input channel by the runtime watcher.

injection_method.description: How the correction is delivered to the agent. Frozen at C0 to the three named methods; expansions require a follow-up issue. Note: multiplexer-send is deprecated (#824) — prefer cli-return (the correction inbox the worker drains); multiplexer-send retained in enum for C0 backward compatibility.
injection_method.$comment: deprecated: multiplexer-send — use cli-return (the worker drains cli-return.jsonl as its correction inbox); retained for C0 backward compatibility (#824)

issued_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the observer issued the correction. The watcher records its own observation time when it injects.

validator_id.description: Optional identifier of the validator whose result triggered the correction.

violation_location.description: Optional `path:line` (or `path:line:col`) location anchor — useful when the correction references a specific site.
